column1: # What a supervisor is told when it asks. The half a record file cannot carry.
# The two supervisor columns are space separated, "-" for none, and they are
# what the CALLER built in its own process. Nothing here is read out of a
# record: that is the shape the whole design turns on, because an unknown schema
# is then answered from a list the caller already holds and there is nowhere for
# the answer to be a fetch.
# The three refusals are three different questions and a supervisor branches on
# which one it got. `unknown_schema` means leave this job alone; `not_supported`
# means this job is mine and this is not one of the things it does;
# `invalid` means the record is wrong and somebody should be told.
# --- a namespaced action does not collide with a bare one ------------------
# --- an action the kind does not declare -----------------------------------
# --- an action the kind declares and this supervisor has not built ----------
# --- what a supervisor holding everything can do ---------------------------
